# milo

> milo provides small terminal panes for a live file tree, Git history, usage, and a read-only file reader. The panes work on their own or alongside your shell in Rex.

milo does not write to the project it displays. Building from source requires Rust 1.91 or later and Git. The Rust crate depends only on `libc`.

## Using milo

- [README](README.md): Installation, Rex setup, pane behavior, keys, and how to read the marks and colors.
- [Source installer](install.sh): Builds milo with Cargo and installs or removes the binary. It does not change Rex or Claude Code settings.
- [Agent skill](skills/milo/SKILL.md): How to check milo and open a reader in the user's terminal, including at a Git commit.

## Developing milo

- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): Build and test instructions, repository safety rules, and source map.
- [Cargo manifest](Cargo.toml): Rust version, dependencies, license, and release profile.
- [Command entry point](src/main.rs): Command syntax, CLI help, and shared terminal loop.
- [Rex setup](src/setup.rs): Setup choices and listener entry point.
